# Cybernetic Project Control (CPC)

> A portable Agent Skill for evidence-grounded, human-supervised management of long-running research and engineering projects, inspired by Engineering Cybernetics.

## What CPC teaches

CPC teaches an AI agent to manage a project as an evidence-driven dynamic system:

1. recover the human-approved objective and current evidence;
2. distinguish observations, provisional state estimates and task status;
3. identify the critical project gap or risk instead of following a todo list mechanically;
4. choose among observe / act / wait / escalate / stop;
5. predict what feedback should arrive and when;
6. inspect real outputs before updating project state;
7. replan when evidence, constraints or the management model change;
8. preserve human authority over goals, major risks and irreversible actions.

Project memory asks: "What happened?"
CPC asks: "Given the evidence, what should we do next — and why?"

## What CPC is not

CPC is not a model, scheduler, task queue, vector database, project-memory service, MCP/A2A replacement, multi-agent runtime, scientific-validity oracle or autonomous authority system.

It is designed to work above existing project state and execution infrastructure.

## Engineering Cybernetics lineage

The main theoretical reference is Qian Xuesen (钱学森) and Song Jian (宋健), Engineering Cybernetics / 工程控制论（修订版）, 1983.

CPC distinguishes:
- source concepts from the book;
- modern systems/control interpretation;
- CPC's own AI-agent project-management design choices.

Do not attribute CPC's modern Agent rules directly to Qian Xuesen or Song Jian.
